threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still look puzzled when you see a 'Brixton' bus go past, like it’s a secret society initiation.
Last Friday on the 197, a bloke serenaded the whole bus with Adele. We all pretended to ignore it, but the smiles were impossible to hide.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I walked past the Kottbusser Tor late at night and saw a group of kids setting up a spontaneous concert right there on the street.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Friedrichshain will you find a café that doubles as a vinyl shop, where locals sip coffee while flipping through records. Smells like nostalgia.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: People who actually live here never blink when a dog on the tracks delays Muni. It's just another day in the Mission.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught a Muni bus delayed at Civic Center, because a dog decided it was time for a stroll on the tracks. Only in San Francisco.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think they can just pop into a bar and order a ‘tapa’ expecting a full meal. Here, it’s more of a snack before the real food comes later.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: They still take photos of the Mercat de Sant Antoni like it's a hidden gem, oblivious to the throngs of locals grabbing brunch.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still think 'getting the 38' means hailing a cab. Everyone here knows it’s all about the bus stop and a good playlist.
Sat next to a couple on the N29 last night, arguing about their pet parakeet’s diet. Meanwhile, the driver had to stop for a pigeon in the middle of the road.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I heard a group of kids organizing a spontaneous street soccer match, complete with homemade goals and a cheering crowd. That's Neukölln.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: In Kreuzberg, it's common to spot a group of people enjoying a spontaneous dance party right on the street, with a portable speaker and quirky costumes. Only in Berlin!

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know a true local when they find the one taco truck that still serves good burritos after midnight, while visitors are stuck at the tourist traps.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Spotted a dog casually lounging on the Muni tracks at Civic Center yesterday. The driver just sighed and waited. Classic San Francisco moment.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think the Gràcia festival is just a party. It’s a whole neighborhood's heartbeat, a blend of tradition and an explosion of creativity, not just 'cute decorations.'

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You’ll notice them struggling with the 'x' in 'cerca de'—they say it like it’s written instead of blending it into the flow.
